claims.claim: Ibrahim Maza is a 20-year-old midfielder, born in Berlin on 24 November 2005
claims.note: Bundesliga and FotMob give 24 Nov 2005 (age 20 on 1 Nov 2026, and on 29 Oct 2026). Club announcement says 'the German-Algerian born in Berlin'.

claims.claim: Leverkusen signed him from Hertha BSC in 2025, contract to 30 June 2030; announced 1 May 2025
claims.note: Club announcement dated 1.05.2025 says contract to 30 June 2030.

claims.claim: He made 44 appearances for Leverkusen in all competitions last season
claims.note: Club says 44 appearances, 5 goals and 7 assists last season.

claims.claim: Maza moved from Hertha's youth section to Leverkusen in the summer of 2025
claims.note: Stated verbatim by the club.

claims.claim: 13 appearances for Germany U18, U19 and U20; opted for Algeria in 2024
claims.note: Verbatim in the club announcement.

claims.claim: Maza was one of the nominees at the Ballon d'Or ceremony in London on 26 October 2026
claims.note: Club confirms 26 October in London; Africa Soccer confirms he was a nominee.

claims.claim: Lamine Yamal won the award, which Africa Soccer calls the Kopa Trophy
claims.note: Source confirms Yamal claimed the Kopa Trophy. Wording is ambiguous right after the Ballon d'Or mention; name the Kopa Trophy directly.

claims.claim: Maza finished ninth in the voting, according to Bulinews
claims.note: Bulinews says ninth-place Kopa Trophy finish. It cites no voting body, so it is single-source; the attribution in the body is correct and must stay.

claims.claim: 'Being here and being one of the nominees is a great honour'
claims.note: Quote verified in source.

claims.claim: Coach Carles Martínez hopes 'Ibo' wins the Ballon d'Or one day
claims.note: Quote verified verbatim: 'I hope Ibo wins the Ballon d'Or one day.'

claims.claim: 'We're very happy with him, and we want him to stay here for many more years'
claims.note: Re-fetched and verified verbatim.

claims.claim: Asked about transfer talk he was not thinking about it; remarks given to Bild
claims.note: Source says Martínez told Bild and is 'not thinking about that'.

claims.claim: Ousmane Dembélé predicted, in replies to Maza's Instagram photos, that Maza would win the Ballon d'Or one day; Africa Soccer paraphrases
claims.note: Source describes a social media exchange responding to Maza's Instagram posts and paraphrases the prediction, so the article is accurate to it.

claims.claim: PSG's interest is 'concrete', Maza's representatives informed, according to Florian Plettenberg as cited by Africa Soccer
claims.note: Source cites Plettenberg; no formal approach decided; PSG not beyond initial assessment.

claims.claim: Sky Germany, cited by Bulinews: PSG considering a January move, no bid mentioned
claims.note: Source confirms January consideration and no bid.

claims.claim: RMC Sport, cited by TSA Algérie: PSG do not plan an offer this winter
claims.note: Dated 28 Oct 2026; headline says he will not go to PSG this winter.

claims.claim: 90min: Leverkusen want to bind him long-term and are working on an early extension
claims.note: Source says Leverkusen want to keep him long-term and no immediate agreement is in sight.

claims.claim: On 27 May 2023 he came on in the 46th minute at Wolfsburg and scored the equaliser in the 55th, Hertha won 2-1
claims.note: Match report: 46' substitution, 55' goal, Wolfsburg 1-2 Hertha.

claims.claim: Simon Rolfes called him 'currently one of the most interesting young attacking players'
claims.note: Verbatim.

claims.claim: Voted Player of the Match in the Champions League away game at Benfica
claims.note: Benfica 1-0 Leverkusen away win in source.

claims.claim: Africa Soccer counted five goals in 45 matches for Leverkusen by September 2026
claims.note: Verbatim press count, dated 11 Sep 2026.

claims.claim: Known in Algeria as 'Mazadona', a reference to Diego Maradona
claims.note: Source confirms nickname.

claims.claim: FotMob lists 24 matches and 3 goals for Algeria since October 2024
claims.note: FotMob: 24 matches, 3 goals since October 2024.

claims.claim: Africa Soccer gave 21 appearances and two goals
claims.note: Source: 21 appearances, two goals.

claims.claim: Algeria at the 2026 World Cup; Maza started all four matches
claims.note: Club: starting all four matches.

claims.claim: Pre-Argentina quotes to Algerian state television ('The first match is very important', 'Calmness will be the key', 'We will beat Messi, God willing')
claims.note: All quotes present in source; source attributes them to Algerian state television.

claims.claim: Ten-player shortlist for Men's Young Talent of the Year, including Lamine Yamal and Yan Diomande
claims.note: Club lists both names.

claims.claim: Africa Soccer describes the shortlist place as his first Ballon d'Or nomination
claims.note: Source: first Ballon d'Or nomination.

claims.claim: Bundesliga profile: 180 cm, shirt number 30
claims.note: Profile shows 180 cm and 30.

claims.claim: Bundesliga profile: 8 appearances, 3 goals, 2 assists in 2026/27
claims.note: Profile shows 2026/2027 stats.

claims.claim: GetFootballNewsGermany, 10 Oct 2026, citing Sky Germany: contract talks beyond 2030; Arsenal, Tottenham, Chelsea, Aston Villa, Manchester City monitoring; no PSG mention
claims.note: Source confirms date, Sky Germany citation, clubs named, and no PSG mention.

claims.claim: Hertha: 'I had the best opportunities to develop and improve with Hertha in the second division'
claims.note: Verbatim in club announcement.

claims.claim: Africa Soccer reports he was at the 2026 ceremony at the London Palladium as a nominee
claims.note: Source names the London Palladium for the ceremony.

valueNote: Adds a dated timeline, the conflicting PSG and contract reports with both sides cited, and the discrepancy between club and press statistics. All sourced figures check out. Quotes match sources. The Kopa ninth place rests on one outlet and is correctly attributed.
summary: All checked claims are confirmed by their cited sources. The ninth-place Kopa Trophy finish is single-source (Bulinews) and stays attributed. No unsupported or outdated claims. Approve for editor use; the 20-year-old age will become stale on 24 November 2026.
